items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: I heard Ma Rene, yeah. ... I liked Mama Rene, because Mama Rene was like, oh, you know, she was a ghetto. She was alright, I liked the way she started singing the blues.

ctx.x: I heard Bessie several times in New York, but I never did hear Ma Rene. You heard Ma Rene?
